adjudication_notes.source_verification_limit: The V3 paths and hashes are supplied source identifiers, not independently computed or verified here. The assertion that the a068 rows are unchanged between V2, V3 and V4 was supplied by C; this reviewer re-read the complete actual a068 primary fields in its own V2 packet, not the corpus files. Conclusions apply to those reviewed fields, conditional on the supplied row-identity assertion.
adjudication_notes.changed_observation: The original review correctly recognized commercial-ledger observations and expressly noted the related reconstitution activity, but represented them in one combined process context. On independently re-reading the full rubric and updated observation-basis clarification, I separate two positively documented contexts. The administrative context retains the original commercial-ledger process and administrative facts, with its basis corrected from representative_measurements_not_simulation to observed_administrative_records. A distinct hot_drink_reconstitution context has contextual_topic_only basis and an empty facts object. Each actual description explicitly relates the drinking-chocolate powder to hot-drink reconstitution bench testing with water; this is a subject statement, not merely a matching word. The ledger qualification denies experimental performance reporting, not that documented subject association. This additional topic context is defensible in all three seeds without inventing experimental measurements.
adjudication_notes.unchanged_observation: No seed documents powder-dose, water-temperature or dissolution-time measurements for a068. Reporting months, dispatched consignments and invoiced prices remain administrative variables, never experimental variables. The primary s09 measurement mismatch therefore remains. For a short ambiguous diagnostic, the frozen rubric does not require experimental measurements, CSV or a non-simulation basis; the documented subject context must not be discarded solely for lacking experimental columns. This observation does not assign any diagnostic grade.
adjudication_notes.limitations: Metadata-level association and distribution consistency only; no downloadable bytes, independent corpus hashes or omitted duplicate queryContext text were inspected. The original raw review is retained unchanged; this file records the scoped clarification rather than replacing that historical review.

Thus both the administrative process and the separate topic-only preparation context are supported. CSV plus two JSON distributions repeat the same three administrative columns, units and examples; no distribution introduces experimental variables. The title describes an account of hot-water reconstitution and the keyword also supports that subject. Unlike the compact 39032 description, this version includes the variable list in its main description and additional reuse prose. The context sentence, fictional location, publisher, example consignment count and price vary, without changing the two-context interpretation. This scoped clarification adds a context and corrects the administrative basis; it does not retract the original measurement mismatch or rewrite the preserved raw review.
